sourceTitle: The Philosophy of the Moral Feelings
description: "The Philosophy of the Moral Feelings" by John Abercrombie is a philosophical treatise written in the early 19th century. This work seeks to explore the inherent moral emotions and principles that govern human conduct, arguing for the importance of aligning moral philosophy with revealed religion.
